question:
(i) Explain why electric charge is a scalar quantity but can have positive and negative signs.
(ii) A body contains $8$ excess protons and $5$ excess electrons. Find the net charge on the body in terms of $e$ and in coulomb.

options.A:
(i) Charge is a vector; positive and negative signs specify its direction
(ii) Net charge is $-3e=-4.8\times10^{-19}\,\text{C}$
options.B:
(i) Charge is a scalar; positive and negative signs indicate nature, not direction
(ii) Net charge is $+3e=+4.8\times10^{-19}\,\text{C}$
options.C:
(i) Charge is a vector because it can be added algebraically
(ii) Net charge is $+13e$
options.D:
(i) Positive and negative signs denote two directions in space
(ii) Net charge is $+40e$
